_comment: [tier] 항목에 'tier': 'premier'(파랑, Premier Conference) 또는 'top'(노랑, Top-tier Conference)을 넣으면 제목/문장 옆에 우수학술대회 배지가 표시됩니다(뉴스·논문 공통, 없으면 표시 안 함). News + members + teaching. Edit this file then run `node tools/build.js`. Homepage shows the most recent items (news 8, members current, teaching = latest year only); full lists on the All-news / All-members / All-teaching pages. News: newest first. 'highlight':true shows the item in blue. Teaching: one entry per term {year, term, courses[]}, newest first. Members: 각 멤버에 "url" 을 넣으면 이름이 그 홈페이지로 하이퍼링크됩니다(홈·멤버 페이지 모두). 링크 없으면 "url":"" 또는 생략. Alumni(동문): members.alumni 배열에 {"name","degree","year","thesis"(선택),"now"(선택),"url"(선택)} 형식으로 추가 — url 넣으면 이름이 홈페이지로 링크됨. 예: { "name": "홍길동", "degree": "MS", "year": 2025, "now": "Samsung", "url": "https://..." }

news.html: Selected as a reviewer for DFF-2026 (Deepfake Forensics Workshop) at the ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM) 2026.

Three papers accepted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal (two papers, on robotic surgery authentication in 6G-enabled IoMT and on a multi-layered defense framework for bio-implantable medical devices) and Computers and Electrical Engineering (post-quantum signcryption for VANETs).
Two papers accepted to IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics on decentralized privacy-preserving schemes for medical IoT and agricultural consumer electronics.
Paper on 6G space-terrestrial handover authentication accepted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (TIFS).
Selected as a Technical Program Committee member for IEEE ICC 2026 and a Program Committee member for IEEE SecDev (2024–2026).
The Information Security & Privacy (ISNP) Lab was established at Gachon University. We are recruiting motivated graduate / undergraduate students and postdocs — please contact with your CV.
